relationship_to_prior_lane: Uses the same causal first-limit platform launch representation as the prior contraction-rebreak lane, but tests a previously untested immediate price-discovery translation. It does not reuse the later contraction or rebreak event.
economic_hypothesis: The first upper-limit close after forty sessions without any upper-limit close, when it also breaks a bounded forty-session platform, reveals demand that remains unsatisfied at the legal price ceiling. The first subsequent legal non-limit open is the earliest executable observation of the new price-discovery regime.

causal_state.history: 40 preceding symbol rows exist; at least 38 are hard-valid/current-valid/tradable.
causal_state.no_recent_limit: zero preceding upper-limit closes in those 40 rows.
causal_state.bounded_platform: preceding-40 maximum coordinate high / minimum coordinate low - 1 <=35%.

trigger.first_limit: signal actual close rounds to at least the registered upper-limit price.
trigger.platform_breakout: signal coordinate close >= preceding-40 maximum coordinate high.
trigger.deduplication: qualifying events no more than 30 market-session indices apart form one symbol cluster; retain its first event.

entry: first legal executable non-limit open within the next three market-session indices; otherwise expire
profile_selection: 2014-2018 only: maximize median annual mean net return, then pooled mean, then shorter horizon.
confirmation: Only selected profile on 2019-2021; require average completed trades/year >50, pooled mean net >3%, pooled median >0, every confirmation-year mean >0.
